verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents a comprehensive Core API (cards, transactions, controls, disputes, webhooks) with a sandbox and interactive browser-based request widgets, giving developers/AI-native users a fully documented public API surface to drive the product programmatically. Probes show no llms.txt/openapi.json at standard well-known paths, but the docs themselves clearly describe REST endpoints and provide a quick-start tutorial for calling them. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec at a discoverable standard location and independent (non-vendor) confirmation of API usability.
